verses.text: A psalm of David, written when he was in the wilderness of Judah. God, you are my God. I search hard for you. My soul is thirsty for you. My whole body longs for you in a dry and tired land where there is no water.
I have seen you in your holy place and seen your power and glory.
Your faithful love is better than life, so my lips will praise you.
I will praise you as long as I live. I will lift up my hands in prayer to you.
I will be satisfied as if I had eaten the richest food. My mouth will sing praises to you with joyful lips.
I remember you when I lie in bed. I think about you through the night.
You have been my helper. I sing for joy in the shadow of your wings.
I hold on to you closely. Your right hand holds me up.
But those who want to kill me will go down into the depths of the earth.
They will be killed by the sword. Jackals will eat their bodies.
But the king will be glad in God. Everyone who makes promises in God's name will praise him, and the mouths of liars will be shut.
